result.quote: may fire come from Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and may fire come from the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech.
result.reason: The curse is mutual: Abimelech is to destroy the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and they are to destroy Abimelech. The key inaccurately says Shechem itself is burned, omits Beth-millo, and does not convey the mutual source of the destruction.
